lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines of varying lengths; spacing is widest at the mid-torso and becomes more compressed and fragmented towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the fourth vertical line from the anterior, splitting into two segments near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 9 through 12 on the posterior flank exhibit significant fragmentation, appearing as dashed or abbreviated segments that do not reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 7 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch, organized in a loosely triangular grouping above the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots align horizontally on the mid-posterior flank, forming a semi-linear geometric pattern parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate trajectory, emerging dorsolaterally from the skull at a 45-degree angle before curving inward and posteriorly at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between apical tips is approximately 0.85 times the width of the aggregate horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The distal 15% of the horn structure displays high-contrast ivory-toned pixels relative to the dark, textured lower segments.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking on the bridge of the muzzle, two distinct white spots on the lateral cheek, and a dark ventral fringe of long hair extending from the neck to the groin.
